## Citeseer transfer interpretation

CITESEER_TRANSFER is DSR A6 versus NCNC A0. Per-seed A6−A0 and R-only A1−A0 MRR changes are listed above; this within-protocol comparison shows whether routing reduces the negative-transfer behavior. Historical absolute scores are not directly compared.

## Router diagnostics

Full subset distributions and A9 correspondence rates are in 07_ROUTER_DIAGNOSTICS.json. Positive/negative groups are retrospective only; router inputs never use labels.

## Interpretation

Small seed counts are screening/replication evidence on fixed validation populations. A candidate-conditioned router gain must be separated from the duplicate GRAPH router and shuffled-context control. Novelty was not audited in this sprint.
